author: build_high
body:
Getting stuck in a block then being teleported back to it had been an issue for ages, it seems as though it had been fixed in my absence, I have been playing for a couple of weeks and had no issues until today. My ping hasn't changed and it occurs every 10-15 seconds making Nebula unplayable, I haven't tried it in any other game-mode as no-one else is in those servers. Also as of last week i was consistently getting 220ms in ping, it has now risen to 350 and my ping is unchanged to other servers.

My guess is that someone tried to fix block-lag and fucked up

Its not just me, I asked in a server and everyone who responded confirmed it is affecting them, even those with good connection.

GrapeSmoothie said it may have something to do with anti-cheat and spambots.
